chunks: "Whoever does not care about what he says and what is said about him, then that is the partnership of Satan. Whoever does not care that people see him as one doing evil, then that is the partnership of Satan. Whoever backbites his believing brother without any grievance between them, then that is the partnership of Satan. And whoever is infatuated with the love of the forbidden and the desire for zina, then that is the partnership of Satan."

Then he عليه السلام said: "A child born of zina has signs. One of them is hatred for us, the Ahl al-Bayt; the second is that he inclines toward the forbidden from which he was created; the third is making light of religion; and the fourth is bad conduct in social presence with people. And no one behaves badly in the presence of his brothers except one who was born upon other than his father's bed, or one whose mother conceived him during her menstruation."

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the Household of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سُوءُ الْمَحْضَرِ: bad conduct in social presence or gatherings
key_terms.شِرْكُ شَيْطَانٍ: participation or share with Satan in corrupt conduct

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about backbiting, shameless wrongdoing, and signs mentioned for a child of zina?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against shameless speech, indifference to public wrongdoing, backbiting, and attachment to haram desire, describing them as forms of Satanic participation. It then lists traits associated in the narration with a child of zina, including hatred of the Ahl al-Bayt, attraction to haram, disrespect toward religion, and offensive conduct toward others.
